title: Portfolio, registry and correspondence operations in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You open the Portfolio page. A top bar shows the "ANDS Studio" brand plus chips: "Help", "Dossier manager", "Guided journey →". Under the "Portfolio" heading, text reads "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance." Three summary cards count "Dossiers", "Ready to file" and "Blocked". Each dossier row shows its ID, a mini module tower, a gate chip ("Ready to file" or a count like "3/7 modules"), a fee chip ("Fee paid", "Fee waived", or "Fee due" with an amount — fees load after the rows, showing "Fee …" briefly), sometimes a litigation clock like "NOA: 12d for brand to act", and links "Open →" and "Viewer". A "Export client status report (CSV)" button downloads a spreadsheet. With no data you see "No dossiers yet." and a link "Create one in the dossier manager →".

You navigate to the Registry page (reachable by URL; the Portfolio top bar does not link to it). Heading: "Product registry" with a "Register product +" button that toggles a form: "Product name", "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456"), "DIN (8 digits)" with live hint "Issued by Health Canada at NOC — leave blank until then." (a wrong entry shows a digit count), "Country", "Drug type", then "Register product →". Each registration row shows the DIN (or "DIN pending"), a status chip such as "Marketed", and transition buttons like "→ Marketed" — or "No further transitions". A "Right-to-Sell deadlines" strip lists per-product due dates (overdue ones say "OVERDUE"), and an "Annual notification checklist" warns "Reminder only — this checklist is stored in your browser and is NOT filed with Health Canada or tracked by the registry service."

The Correspondence page (again reached by URL, /correspondence) is headed "Correspondence & notices". A "Dossier" field pre-fills with your first dossier; typing an ID (placeholder "e123456") and pressing "Open" reveals three stacked panels. "Notice inbox": if no lifecycle exists you're told to start one and click "Start lifecycle"; otherwise you pick a notice type (SAL, SDN, NOC…), a date, and click e.g. "Ingest SAL", guided by the hint "Screening: SAL / SDN / SRL · Review decisions: NOC / NOD / NON". A confirmation reports the record logged and any response window. "Correspondence hub" lists every exchange with direction chips ("HC → sponsor" / "sponsor → HC"), a kind filter, and a "Log correspondence +" form ending in "Log record". "Form V / NOA register" lets you "File Form V +" per patent, then "Serve NOA" and "Record s.6 action", with live day-counters for the "45-day action window" and "24-month stay".
